output_list.code: function _transfer(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal {            require(_to != 0x0);            require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value);            require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);            uint previousBalances = balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to];            balanceOf[_from] -= _value;            balanceOf[_to] += _value;            emit Transfer(_from, _to, _value);            assert(balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances);        }
